shots.pre: Medium shot inside the same tent at eye level, from the camp-bed side, a reverse angle: Napoleon alone at the table.
shots.post: He leans on the table with both hands and studies the map.
shots.layout: The camera stands by the camp bed on the left wall and looks across the tent at the table; the entrance flap is behind the camera, the lantern hangs above the table.

shots.pre: Close-up insert of the large map on the wooden table inside the same tent: a man's finger rests on a town.
shots.post: The lantern light falls on the map and the finger.
shots.layout: The camera looks straight down at the table from above; only the map, the finger and the table edge are in the picture.

shots.pre: Wide shot inside the same tent from the back of the tent: the general comes in through the entrance flap holding a letter.
shots.post: Napoleon stands at the table with his back half turned to the entrance.
shots.layout: The camera stands at the back of the tent opposite the entrance; the entrance flap is in the right wall, the camp bed on the left wall, the table in the middle, the lantern above it.

shots.pre: Medium shot over the general's shoulder inside the same tent: Napoleon reads the letter.
shots.post: He holds the letter in both hands and frowns.
shots.layout: The camera stands behind the general's right shoulder; Napoleon faces the camera across the table; the camp bed is behind him.
shots.change: Cut to a medium shot over the general's shoulder: Napoleon reads the letter.
